Eric, saw ServiceTrade launched Stella, your AI-agent suite for commercial contractors, on top of 1,300-plus customers.

A new AI product usually means a bigger pipeline target, and more contractors in market than reps can cover before they ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ServiceTrade off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

With Stella to push into the contractor base, pipeline expectations usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ServiceTrade needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Eric, last bit of proof for ServiceTrade.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ServiceTrade's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
